answer: Each identity draws at most 10 POA daily via a trust score decaying 5% per draw; newcomers wait 7 days per draw, and proven duplication zeroes scores and freezes the faucet for 30 days. A narrow canyon holds honest flow steady; a sybil herd never beats one patient's share. Each extra fake adds the same 10 POA trickle yet demands another 7-day wait and another key to tend, so 100 fakes cost 100 times the patience and upkeep, a spiral growing with each head. All draws and score changes sit on-chain in quartz clarity, so any verifier replays the ledger and checks all allowances and slash records.
